verdict.what: a walled desert trading post with a crenellated sandstone parapet and a central entrance portal
verdict.style: Old West / desert fort-market, sandstone and terracotta
verdict.summary: A solid low box with a good sandstone-and-terracotta palette and a readable central entrance, but the parapet reads as a flat lid and the red walls are large unbroken sheets that need depth, so it needs one more pass before it's placeable.
